name: FEDOT.LLM
install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv sync --dev

terminals.name: streamlit
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export FEDOTLLM_LLM_API_KEY="${FEDOTLLM_LLM_API_KEY:-set-your-key-in-the-ui}"; export FEDOTLLM_EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY="${FEDOTLLM_EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY:-set-your-key-in-the-ui}"; export LANGFUSE_HOST="${LANGFUSE_HOST:-https://cloud.langfuse.com}"; export LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY="${LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY:-}"; export LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY="${LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY:-}"; uv run python -m streamlit run fedotllm/web/app.py --server.port=8080 --server.address=0.0.0.0 --server.headless=true
